## Highlights

- Preserve native script exits, bounded output and cleanup diagnostics; distinguish an interpreter launch failure from an observed payload result.
- Honor cancellation while acquiring SQL resources for affected authorization, inspection and group cleanup. Cancel MCP lifecycle admission without changing listener or credential state; committed revocation still completes bounded cleanup independently.
- Diagnose owned Windows runtimes and daemon requests with opt-in incident collection and bounded replay selections, retaining original outcomes and controller provenance. These documented backward-compatible maintainer additions select v1.7.0 under the declared SemVer policy.
- Synchronize browser Search query entry with completed route focus, preserving keyboard/zoom expectations and bounded failure traces. Refresh the API runtime, YAML, Vite and coupled Next/Fumadocs dependencies; retain SQLite 1.60.1/libc 1.77.1 while the documented driver correction remains unpublished.
- Retain schema v24 introduced in v1.6.0. Follow the platform guides for a complete stopped-state database/sidecar, configuration and protected-credential backup, and restore that state with matching older binaries for rollback.
- Original Windows runtime/prerequisite and inspection causes remain unconfirmed in [#355](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/355) and [#356](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/356); historical reconstruction/controller limits remain documented. Current success does not establish their causes. Attended native observations remain untested under the standing native-testing waiver; automated CI and artifact checks remain required.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.7.0/CHANGELOG.md#170---2026-10-27) for every change.
